name: Hotel Maximillian
beschreibung: Hotel Maximilian is situated right in the historic Old Town of Innsbruck, only moments from the iconic Golden Roof. Despite its prime central setting, it enjoys a peaceful pedestrian atmosphere. The surrounding Nordkette mountains offer scenic summer trails and effortless transit to regional ski areas like Patscherkofel and Axamer Lizum. Accommodations include contemporary en-suite rooms, a wellness suite with sauna and steam bath, and an elegant bar lounge.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Maximilian in Innsbruck's historic Old Town features stylish boutique rooms, a sauna and steam bath, an inviting bar, and quick access to the Nordkette mountains.
